name: CMOS 2-bit current-steering DAC
description: An 11-MOS two-bit DAC steers binary-weighted NMOS mirror currents into complementary 22 kohm loads. A 10 uA external reference sets nominal 10 uA and 20 uA legs; two CMOS inverters generate bit complements. The output voltage falls as code=2*d1+d0 rises. All four codes are checked using the resistor-derived sink current, along with the complementary-current sum. Generic Level-1 nominal demonstration; current-source output resistance causes finite gain error. No INL/DNL, glitch, matching, settling-time or foundry qualification is claimed.
